title: Ada’s note to the borrowing room on Bridge Street
titleZh: 艾達寫給橋街借用室的訊息
passage:
Hello, I’m writing about last night’s loan and our next rehearsal. Before last night’s rehearsal I’d already signed out case 06 at your staffed desk. The compact “Willow Walk” folder in its pocket had parts for only one player. When another player joined, I came back for the full-size duet folder from shelf B. I kept the original case, and the new slip read ‘Willow Walk — duet; issued with case 06.’ Len wondered whether that meant the music belonged inside the case.

I remembered the note on your counter: only compact folders fit the pocket. You also said that if we swap music while keeping the same case, the desk adds the new arrangement to that loan rather than checking the case out again. One detail about that duet folder: it had two pages to put on separate stands. In our copy the chord page had two opening bars under the heading “Willow Walk.” Len played them while I waited to start the tune. A note by the locker says its inside gate starts in the single-folder position. The button marked Together changes the gate before anything goes in, sending the next deposit to the wide tray. The gate resets when the flap closes. The desk can use the old checkout slip to find the loan. A return slip, though, lists only pieces that staff have seen. If one piece is at the desk and the other is still being traced, keep both notes on the same loan, but don’t list the second piece as returned until it has been found.

One thing for this morning’s staff: Len took the folder to the after-hours locker after rehearsal. He told me it went through the flap and the screen said ‘item accepted,’ but the printer was out of paper. The slip in the case is from our original checkout, not from the locker. Len still has the case. I remember the last time we borrowed one, you said only folders can be returned through the locker. Cases have to go back to the staffed desk, which can also deal with missing locker confirmations. Len added a detail when he called. ‘I pressed Together and opened the flap. I couldn't get the folder out of my bag with one hand, so I shut the flap empty. When I opened it again the screen still showed Together. I put in the folder without choosing again. The case was never in the locker.’ He wanted to know where staff would start looking. Len can come before work with the case and the old slip. He won’t be there when the first locker trays are checked. He would like a slip to show what he handed over at the desk.

Next week Len and I want to play “Willow Walk” again. Could you check the compact folder on shelf C? I can read the full tune but can’t fill in a missing section from memory. We’ll still use two stands. When we tried counting in from the tops of both pages last night, I finished the first line before Len even reached the chords for it.

Len needs chord names, not written-out accompaniment. He’d like to keep the short solo opening, then accompany me as soon as my tune starts. Last night we made it work by adding a mark to my page, after which we could start without looking over at the other stand. We can’t write on the loan copy next week. Thanks for checking. — Ada
passageZh:
你好，我想說明昨晚借用的情況，也想問問下次排練需要的樂譜。昨天排練前，我已經在有人值班的櫃檯辦好 06 號樂器盒的借用。樂器盒側袋裡那份小型《柳樹步道》譜夾只供一人演奏。後來有另一位演奏者加入，我回去換了 B 架上較大的雙人譜夾。我仍用原本的盒子，新單據上寫著「柳樹步道：雙人版本；隨 06 號盒借出」。連恩不確定這是否表示樂譜應該放進盒裡。

我記得櫃檯上的說明：那個袋子只放得下小型譜夾。你們也說，如果保留同一個盒子、只更換樂譜，櫃檯會在原借用紀錄裡加上新的編曲版本，不會再辦一次借盒手續。 補充一下，那份二重奏譜有兩頁，要各放在一個譜架上。我們那份譜中，和弦頁在〈柳樹步道〉標題下有兩小節前奏。連恩彈這兩小節時，我等著進入旋律。 歸還櫃旁的說明寫著，內部擋板一開始會把物品送到單份譜夾盤。投放前按下標為「一起還」的按鈕，就會切換擋板，使下一次投放的物品進入寬盤。投入口關上後，擋板會回到原位。 櫃檯可以用原借出單查到借用紀錄，但歸還單只列工作人員確實看過的物品。如果一件已送到櫃檯、另一件仍在查找，可在同一筆借用留下兩則紀錄；找到第二件之前，不能把它列為已歸還。

還有一件事要跟今天早上的值班人員說：連恩排練後把譜夾帶到非營業時間的歸還櫃。他說譜夾已經通過投入口，螢幕也顯示「已接收物品」，只是印表機沒紙了。盒裡的單據是原先借出時拿到的，不是歸還櫃印的。盒子還在連恩手上。我記得上次借用時，你們說只有譜夾可以投進歸還櫃。盒子必須拿到有人值班的櫃檯還，櫃檯也可以處理歸還櫃沒印出確認單的情形。 連恩打電話時補充了一件事：「我按了『一起還』並打開投入口。我單手拿不出袋裡的譜夾，就先空著把投入口關上。再打開時，螢幕仍顯示『一起還』。我沒再選一次，就把譜夾投進去。盒子從來沒放進歸還櫃。」他想知道工作人員會先去哪裡找譜夾。 連恩上班前能帶盒子和原借出單過來。等工作人員第一次檢查歸還櫃收件盤時，他已經不在了。他想拿一張單據，證明自己在櫃檯交還了什麼。

 下週我和連恩想再合奏〈柳樹步道〉。能否幫我們查看 C 層架上的小開本樂譜？我能照譜讀完整旋律，但沒辦法憑記憶補上缺段。我們仍會用兩個譜架。昨晚我們試著一起從各自樂頁頂端數拍進入，結果我已奏完第一行，連恩還沒彈到那一行的和弦。

 連恩需要和弦名稱，不是逐音寫出的伴奏譜。他想保留短短的獨奏前奏，旋律一開始就替我伴奏。昨晚我們在我那一頁加了個記號，之後不必往另一個譜架看也能順利開始。下週的借用譜不能寫字。謝謝你幫忙確認。艾達
